about: Options the code tables do not list, and facts they do not carry (licence, maturity and why), for kit/stagereg.py. Public: nothing private goes in this file; private-only options are in a second file that public copies do not have. Every maturity other than default or validated says why.

options.name: catalog
options.by: the scan's published surface prediction and normal grids from the open-data catalog (the organisers' nnU-Net surface model m7 where the catalog names it; AutoPipeline records it as resolved.prediction_model)

options.name: scroll-lens-recto
options.licence: see the model card (Scroll Lens pins it)
options.by: surface_recto_3dunet on 128 or 256 voxel cubes, in the Scroll Lens Space
options.why: a cube viewer, not a whole-scan prediction; no held-out comparison with m7 recorded here

options.name: forrest-surface
options.by: Forrest's surface predictions published with his volcomp volumes on dl.ash2txt.org
options.why: no held-out comparison with m7 recorded here; read from its own host at run time, never copied

options.name: villa
options.by: villa's vc_grow_seg_from_seed on the published surface prediction and normal grids

options.name: villa-neural
options.why: no held-out comparison with villa's standard tracer recorded here

options.name: reader-v2
options.by: Reader v2, Domenico Russo's fine-tune of ink_9um
options.why: scored on PHerc0841, held out from it, against the reverse-depth control (public docs/results.json, results)

options.name: ink_9um-seed42
options.by: the organisers' 9 um ink model, seed 42 at step 75,000
options.why: scored on PHerc0841, held out from it, against the reverse-depth control (public docs/results.json, results)

options.name: ink_9um-seed43
options.by: the organisers' 9 um ink model, seed 43 at step 75,000
options.why: scored on PHerc0841, held out from it, against the reverse-depth control (public docs/results.json, results)

options.name: d9v2
options.licence: none stated on its model page (checked 25 Oct 2026); fetched from its own repo, never copied
options.why: scored on PHerc0841, held out from it, against the reverse-depth control (public docs/results.json, results)

options.name: v8in
options.by: v8in, Youssef Nader's ResNet3D-50 ink model
options.why: scored on PHerc0841, held out from it, against the reverse-depth control (public docs/results.json, results)

options.name: villa-lasagna
options.by: villa's lasagna net (predict3d: cos, grad_mag, normals) and its surface fit (lasagna/fit.py)
options.why: the community's method; its fields are what Lasagna Fields publishes

options.name: lasagna-fields
options.licence: see the Space (villa's outputs on challenge open data)
options.by: villa's lasagna predict3d outputs for ten scans, shared by the Lasagna Fields Space

options.name: villa-spiral-fit
options.by: villa's spiral fit of the whole roll

options.name: scroll-text-reader
options.by: Scroll Text Reader (kit letterread): Greek letter hypotheses from an ink map, with null and control reads
options.why: letter hypotheses, not readings; no passing held-out read of a scroll recorded here

options.name: tesseract
options.by: local Tesseract language packs through kit's reader backends (kit/reader_backends.py)
options.why: general OCR packs, not trained on ink maps of Greek scroll letters

options.name: fibercheck-local
options.by: fibercheck's free local judge (a small CNN on the CPU, no key): per-patch fiber evidence against a phase-scrambled copy, with a self-check against noise, blur and scramble
options.why: passed its preregistered held-out test on PHerc0500P2 and PHerc0343P, above the pixel measure on the gap and tile-shuffle controls (docs/tools/fibercheck.md)

options.name: fibercheck-claude
options.licence: Apache-2.0 (code); Claude through the user's own Anthropic key
options.by: the same check with Claude as the judge, asked in both orders, capped by --max-usd
options.why: Claude's fiber answers were valid on four public scrolls under the frozen fiber controls, but this checker form has no held-out run of its own recorded here
options.reach: python3 scripts/fibercheck/fibercheck.py score --judge claude (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), or the Space with your own key
